death_prophet_witchcraft.name: Witchcraft
death_prophet_witchcraft.description: Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and spell cooldown reduction.

death_prophet_carrion_swarm.name: Crypt Swarm
death_prophet_carrion_swarm.description: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
death_prophet_carrion_swarm.lore: Krobelus' many trips to the grave gather a flock of the damned.
death_prophet_carrion_swarm.note0: Can hit units up to 1110 range away.
death_prophet_carrion_swarm.note1: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

death_prophet_silence.name: Silence
death_prophet_silence.description: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.
death_prophet_silence.lore: Peering into the veil of her opponent's demise, Krobelus sees a silent future.

death_prophet_spirit_siphon.name: Spirit Siphon
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.description: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.shard_description: Increases Spirit Siphon charges by %shard_bonus_charges% and causes enemies to be feared for %shard_fear_duration% seconds if they are siphoned for %shard_consecutive_siphon_duration% seconds consecutively.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.note0: Cannot cast multiple on same target.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.lore: Krobelus willingly shows others the path she alone cannot follow.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.2_description: The hero creates a mystical link with the enemy creature, transferring its health to himself.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.2_note0: Cannot cast multiple on same target.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.2_lore: Krobelus willingly shows others the path she alone cannot follow.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.3_description: The hero creates a mystical link with the enemy creature, transferring its health to himself.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.3_note0: Cannot cast multiple on same target.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.3_lore: Krobelus willingly shows others the path she alone cannot follow.

death_prophet_exorcism.name: Exorcism
death_prophet_exorcism.description: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
death_prophet_exorcism.scepter_description: Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.
death_prophet_exorcism.lore: Over time, the banshee remnants of her previous lives return to haunt the present.
death_prophet_exorcism.note0: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
death_prophet_exorcism.note1: Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.
